label: Domestic Interior
description: The ordinary rooms of a home. architecture/interior collects designed and grand spaces; this is where people actually live — the bathroom, the hallway, the box room used as an office.

items.name: bathroom-tiled
items.text: A small tiled bathroom, a mirror fogged at the edges, bottles crowding one corner of the tub and a towel over the radiator.
items.text_short: small tiled bathroom, mirror fogged at the edges

items.name: bathroom-clawfoot
items.text: A bathroom built around a clawfoot tub, black-and-white floor tiles, a brass mixer and a folding screen half-drawn.

items.name: bedroom-unmade
items.text: A bedroom with the bed left unmade, curtains still half-drawn, clothes over a chair back and a book face-down on the covers.

items.name: walk-in-wardrobe
items.text: A walk-in wardrobe of open rails and lit shelving, shoes ranked by heel height, a mirror at the end and a stool in the middle.
items.text_short: walk-in wardrobe of lit rails and ranked shoes

items.name: hallway-narrow
items.text: A narrow hallway with coats layered on hooks, shoes kicked against the skirting, post on the mat and a stripe of light under a door.
items.text_short: narrow hallway, coats layered on hooks

items.name: home-office-spare-room
items.text: A home office wedged into a spare room, a desk against the window, cables gathered badly and a shelf of things that live nowhere else.
items.text_short: home office wedged into a spare room

items.name: attic-room
items.text: An attic room under sloping rafters, a skylight throwing one bright rectangle onto bare boards, boxes stacked along the low wall.
items.text_short: attic under sloping rafters, one bright skylight

items.name: basement-utility
items.text: A basement utility room, a boiler ticking, a washing machine mid-cycle and a strip light buzzing over a chest freezer.

items.name: living-room-lived-in
items.text: A lived-in living room, a deep sagging sofa, a rug that has moved a hundred times and shelves that stopped being ordered years ago.
items.text_short: lived-in living room with a sagging sofa

items.name: home-workshop
items.text: A home workshop in a garage bay, a pegboard of outlined tools, a vice on the bench and sawdust in the corners of everything.
items.text_short: garage workshop with a pegboard of tools

items.name: conservatory
items.text: A conservatory of white-framed glass, cane chairs and too many plants, condensation gathering low and heat building under the roof.

items.name: stairwell-landing
items.text: A stairwell landing with a worn runner and a turned newel post, framed pictures climbing the wall and a window on the half-landing.
items.text_short: stairwell landing with a worn runner

items.name: studio-flat
items.text: A studio flat where every function overlaps, a bed against the kitchen counter, one good lamp and everything else chosen to fold away.
items.text_short: studio flat where every function overlaps

items.name: nursery-quiet
items.text: A quiet nursery in soft neutral tones, a cot under a mobile, a low chair in the corner and a nightlight left switched on.
items.text_short: quiet neutral nursery with a mobile over the cot
